name: video-editor
description: Descript-like video editor with an MCP server, powered by the ffmpeg CLI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @ve/core" "npm run dev -w @ve/server" "npm run dev -w @ve/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ve/core && npm run build -w @ve/server && npm run build -w @ve/mcp && npm run build -w @ve/web
scripts.mcp: npm run build -w @ve/core && npm run build -w @ve/mcp && npm run start -w @ve/mcp
